create_GlmAsrEncoderConfig: create a GlmAsrEncoderConfig instance with custom encoder parameters like hidden_size and num_hidden_layers
configure_GlmAsrEncoder_defaults: configure a GlmAsrEncoderConfig using default values with 1280 hidden size and 32 layers
initialize_GlmAsrConfig: initialize a GlmAsrConfig with default audio and text sub-configurations for the GLM-ASR model
build_GlmAsrConfig_from_dicts: build a GlmAsrConfig from dict audio_config and text_config that resolve to GlmAsrEncoderConfig and LlamaConfig
merge_text_config_defaults: merge custom text_config dict with _default_text_config_kwargs to override LlamaConfig parameters like num_key_value_heads
